digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center live-testing & agentic probe framework
propositions: amd64 Jira DC harness boots only in CI; arm64 hosts stall under emulation, forcing expensive 2h push→CI cycles for each live defect investigation
rich-text stored as None is re-emitted perpetually, requiring root-cause analysis against a live DC instance but current setup makes iteration prohibitively slow
an agentic investigator running in a single ephemeral DC boot can perform many live experiments via persistent Python REPL and raw REST tools, replacing the multi-cycle observation pattern

the probe is gated by opt-in environment flags (REBAR_DC_RICHTEXT_PROBE, REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL) and runs against any reachable DC (local or CI) without modifying src/rebar or running on ordinary push/PR/schedule
the structured RichTextRca finding returned by the agent cites experiment evidence and is produced solely for investigation; the probe itself does not assert correctness or fail if the bug reproduces
